headline: Over 30 shops gutted as fire rips through furniture market in Karachi's Gulistan-i-Johar
description: <p>KARACHI: Over 30 shops were destroyed when a blaze erupted at a furniture market in Karachi’s Gulistan-i-Jauhar in the early hours of Friday.</p> <p>No injuries were reported, according to police and rescue services officials and the fire was later brought under control.</p> <p>Rescue 1122 spokesperson Hassaan Ul Haseeb Khan said the fire erupted in a furniture market near Kamran Chowrangi. It spread rapidly due to the presence of wooden goods, engulfing the whole market, he said, adding that it also spread to nearby residential areas and even engulfed a house.

headline: 'I will never go back to sea': 11 fishermen released from Indian captivity reunite with families in Karachi
description: <p>KARACHI: 11 Pakistani fishermen, after spending several years in Indian jails for unknowingly crossing over to Indian waters while fishing, were reunited with their families in Karachi on Friday morning.</p> <p>The men were <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2026048">handed over</a> through the Wagah Border by Indian authorities some two months ago. On Friday, the Edhi Foundation brought them from Lahore to Karachi by ambulance. They arrived at 11:30am at the Edhi Centre near Merewether Tower, where their families had been waiting since morning.</p> <p

headline: PSL franchises allowed seven retentions, must release top-tier player if maximum limit exercised
description: <p>Pakistan Super League (PSL) franchises will be allowed to retain a maximum of seven players, including their direct signing, for the 12th edition of the tournament, but any side exercising the full retention allowance will have to release a player from the highest price tier of the previous auction into the general player pool.</p> <p>The provision, unanimously approved by all eight franchises at a tournament operations workshop at Gaddafi Stadium on Thursday, is among the key regulations finalised ahead of the PSL 12 player auction scheduled for January 23.</p> <

headline: Short-term inflation rises to 11.32pc in last week of October, driven by perishable food prices
description: <p>ISLAMABAD: Short-term inflation rose to 11.32 per cent year-on-year in the week ending October 29, driven largely by perishable food products, according to official data released by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS) on Friday.</p> <p>The index, comprising 51 items whose prices are collected from 50 markets in 17 cities, is calculated weekly to track changes in the prices of essential commodities and services.</p> <p>Short-term inflation has <a href="https://www.dawn.com/news/2037605">remained</a> in double digits for several consecutive weeks,

headline: Crypto exchange Binance freezes assets after $6.3bn 'complex' security breach
description: <p>Cryptocurrency platform Binance said Friday it was working to resolve a “complex attack” that hit around $6.3 billion in funds, with about half that amount frozen to prevent a massive theft.</p> <p>The company — the world’s largest crypto exchange by daily trading volumes — said investigations had “uncovered additional points of breach”, contrary to initial findings that suggested the hack involved a single compromised laptop.</p> <p>“This was a complex attack, and we are doing all we can in coordination with law enforcement to resolve it,” Binance wrote on X.&
